paragraphs: Welcome to LanXgrow. I'm Lan-X, your English communication mentor.
Take your time, and speak in your own words. We'll work through this together.
Here is one way to make your meaning clearer. Say: "Yesterday, I went to the market."
Now try that sentence once more, at a comfortable pace. Focus on the past tense.
Progress comes from practice. Let's take the next step.
